ｅｔｃ／花堂大尉"I see... Time, then. Requisitioning ends as of this moment."

ｅｔｃ／花堂大尉"That does not matter! Civilians are resources also. Keep them alive, and who benefits? Only the enemy."
ｅｔｃ／花堂大尉"For the sacred war of expulsion still to comecome, even one seed of future trouble is one too many. Burn everything!"
ｅｔｃ／花堂大尉"This is for the greater cause!!"
ｅｔｃ／六波羅兵"Yes, ma'am!"

............Huh?

What was this?
Had I... fallen?

Why?

...My side was hot.


My hand met something sticky. Heavy liquid <ruby>clung<rt>clinging</rt></ruby> between my fingers.

I'd been seeing a lot of this lately.

Even now it was flowing out strongly.
From the small hollow my searching fingertips sank into.

A small, burst-open hole in the flesh.

—Had I been shot?

en.html:
義清"But I know you. We met only once. Your eyes made an impression, somehow. And that man, on his side, had such a needlessly gloomy air."
義清"Even then, if Lord Nyuudou hadn't said anything, I would surely have forgotten you. Yes, he noticed. Not that saying so now serves any purpose."
義清"He knew you were enemies from the start. Ah... but nothing can be done without his enjoying it. He should have disposed of you quickly. Instead, all that elaborate work..."
義清"And he was killed in return. That day. That night... 'One more game,' he said, and went out. He never came back. Why didn't I stop him?"
義清"No... before that. Why didn't I cut you down when I first met you?"
義清"You. Yes, you・・. It was you, wasn’t it? Not the man."
義清"Lord Nyuudou never said. But I could tell. It was you he liked. You who stirred that playful mood・・・... heh!"
義清"Then it must be you. Under that clouded moon, you must have been his companion. He played with you, took the game too far, and fell into the land of the dead."
義清"Isn't that so...? Yes. Yes, it is. Of course it is."
義清"You. You killed Lord Nyuudou. I know..."
正宗《...What is this fellow? A madman?》

義清 「でも私は貴方を知ってる。 　会ったのは一度だけ。けど目付きが何だか 印象的だったもの。男の方は男の方でむやみ やたらに雰囲気が暗かったし」
義清 「それでも入道様が何も言わなかったらすぐ に忘れたろうね、きっと。 　そうだよ？　あの御方は気付いてた。今更 言うことでもないんだろうけど」
義清 「貴方たちが敵だって最初から知ってたんだ。 　ああ……なのに。あの御方は何事も楽しま ないと気が済まないから。手早く始末なされ ば良かったのに。手管を妙に凝るものだから」
義清 「返り討ちに遭ってしまわれた。 　あの日。あの晩……もうひと遊びじゃ、と お出掛けになった入道様はそれきり戻られな かった。どうしてお止めしなかったんだろう」
義清 「違う……それよりも前だ。 　どうして私は、貴方と会ったその時に斬り 捨ててしまわなかったんだ？」
義清 「貴方。そう貴方・・だ。貴方だろう？ 　男の方じゃない」
義清 「入道様はどうとも仰せにならなかったけど。 でも私にはわかった。入道様のお気に召した のは、戯れ心・・・を起こされたのは、貴方のほう だって……ふふっ！」
義清 「だから、貴方だ。あの月の翳る夜、入道様 のお相手を務めたのは貴方に違いない。 　入道様は貴方と遊び、戯れが過ぎて冥途へ 落ちてしまわれたに違いない」
義清 「そうでしょう……？ 　そう。そうだ。やっぱりそうだ」
義清 「貴方なんだ。貴方が入道様を殺した。 　私は、知ってる……」
正宗 《……何だ、此奴。 　狂い人か？》

en.text:
What?
...Something had been thrown at us.

The bundle in his other hand, the one without the gun.
He seemed to have scattered its contents.

Something... liquid...
No, solid things were mixed in also.

Hard things and soft things.
One of the hard things had fallen on my cheek.

I picked it up.
White. Thin.


The slightest pressure broke it with a soft snap.
Brittle.

Liquid and soft matter clung to it.
The liquid was thick and sludgy・・・・, the soft matter wet and pulpy・・・・・・.

What was this?

...Think a little, and surely I would know.
For some reason, though, I didn't want to think.

Didn't want to understand.
Didn't want to know what it was.

Because.
Whatever way I looked at it, this was◆       's◆    .
